component.name: Openotes
component.summary: Offline-first encrypted notes that sync over your own WebDAV server

description.p: Openotes is a notes application that keeps every note on your own machine and encrypts it end to end. There is no account to create and no hosted service behind it: notes live in an encrypted local database, and synchronising between your own devices happens over a WebDAV server you already control, such as Nextcloud, ownCloud or a plain WebDAV share.

Openotes is a fork of Notesnook, the GPL-3.0 notes application by Streetwriters (Private) Limited. It keeps the editor, the note model and the encryption of the original, and replaces Notesnook Cloud with encrypted WebDAV sync. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or supported by Streetwriters, and it never contacts Notesnook servers.

ul.li: Rich text notes, notebooks, tags, colours and reminders
Notes encrypted at rest in a local SQLite database
End-to-end encrypted sync over any WebDAV server
Encrypted backups, locally or to the same WebDAV server
No account, no subscription, no telemetry

description.p: First release of the Openotes fork: the Notesnook desktop app rebuilt on Deno with an OS webview instead of Electron, with Notesnook Cloud replaced by end-to-end encrypted WebDAV sync and encrypted local or WebDAV backups. Accounts, subscriptions and telemetry are gone.
